title: GitVault
tagline: Defend your code from censorship and boost your on-chain developer reputation with ENS and Walrus!

prizes.placement: Best app using Walrus for storage
prizes.title: Best app using Walrus for storage

description: With GitVault, you can transition your codebases from GitHub to decentralised storage backups to ensure that your codebase stays bulletproof from censorship. GitVault also helps developers build a reputation on-chain by moving your contributions from GitHub to the decentralized web.
how_its_made: The project uses GitHub actions to push the codebase into Walrus - a decentralised storage protocol through GitVault's ENS integration. The ENS subnames and primary names map your repository metadata map your Github identities to Walrus Blob IDs making sure that your contributions are on-chain as a part of your web3 identity.
